text:
maya: Flagging PR #4599. /classify API ref has two mismatches: request example shows "labels: "positive,negative"" (string) but schema requires ["positive","negative"] array. Also response example uses "probs" but runtime returns "probabilities". Need quick docs + snippet sweep.

sam: Oof. Which snippets ship this file? I see curl, python, and js. Likely breaks copy-paste.

ryan: Runtime accepts the comma string today for backcompat but will stop in next patch. We should update all examples to canonical shapes and add a tiny migration note showing how to split the string.

maya: PR link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4599  - top-level /classify.md examples changed but some old examples remain in sdk_snippets/classify_examples.md.

docs-bot: Checklist added to PR: update request examples (curl/python/js), update response example key, add migration note and one-liner.

sam: I'll fix the JS and curl snippets. New curl sample to use JSON array:

curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/classify 
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $KEY' 
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' 
  -d '{"model":"rw-class","inputs":"text to label","labels":["positive","negative"]}'

ryan: For CHANGELOG: short blurb: "/classify: normalize labels to array form; comma-string coercion deprecated and will be removed next minor. Map \"a,b\" -> [\"a\",\"b\"]". Include a jq one-liner for bulk migration.

sam: Will also update Python snippet to use ['positive','negative'] and change response parsing to resp['probabilities'] instead of resp['probs'].

docs-bot: Reminder set to run docs build after snippets updated. Marking PR needs-docs-review.

maya: Thanks. Ping when CI passes and I'll merge after approvals. :thumbsup:
